When it survives it feeds the predicative kind-raise, the copula predicates it, and the governed preposition's object -- which is the ADJECTIVE'S COMPLEMENT -- is stranded and reattaches as an adjunct on the subject. _provenance_note_2026-07-25-budget-2048: Second half of the budget work: the enumeration bound no longer decides the grammar. (1) `erase_senses`/`normalize_holes` MOVED INTO THE KERNEL (dcg::skeleton) — the gate's notion of 'same structure' and the parser's are now ONE function; if the parser's were coarser it could drop a bracketing the gate then reports as a lost reading. (2) Both bounded stages spend their budget ACROSS BRACKETINGS (skeleton::spread_over_keys), not down a cost prefix. A cost prefix is biased SYSTEMATICALLY, not incidentally: a deeper derivation costs more, so the first readings a prefix drops are the deeply-NESTED ones — the correct PP attachments. Witness: on 'PARP-1 inhibitors are successful in cancers with deficiencies in homologous recombination.' the fully-nested reading ('in [cancers with [deficiencies in HR]]') was skel[12] of 13, i.e. outside EVERY prefix. (3) DEFAULT_FOREST_CAP 256 -> 2048 (CLASSIFY_BUDGET tracks it). At 256 the constant was measuring itself: that unit's skeleton count tracked k directly, 256 -> 2, 1024 -> 6, 2048 -> 13. MEASURED (drift-free replay, same ranks + snapshot): grammar-gap 0, readings 1089 -> 2526, skeletons 301 -> 590, encoded 9, 59s wall, 2.7GB peak RSS, no OOM. Units still binding the budget: 9 -> 4. THE NUMBER IS A STEP, NOT THE DESIGN — there is no constant at which this stops binding (at 4096 the 24-token Project-Achilles unit still offered 5920 distinct candidates), and the OOM justification in the CLASSIFY_BUDGET doc is STALE (the witnessed ~400-candidate SIGKILL predates the distinct-sem dedup). 2048 is adopted because it is strictly better than 256 on every measurement taken AND because the truncation is no longer silent: it logs what it drops, and as the expected-reading corpus approaches full coverage a truncated-away correct reading TRIPS THE FAITHFULNESS GATE instead of hiding in an improving metric. That pairing is the feedback loop this constant never had. PINS 38 -> 42: the <=5-skeleton unpinned units were adjudicated from per-skeleton glosses; 4 pinned, 7 deliberately NOT, and the 7 fall into THREE DEFECT CLASSES that are now the standing grammar work. (a) VERB-MODIFYING ADVERBS ARE DROPPED — 'Somatic MMR inactivation TYPICALLY arises from…', 'The MSI relationship compared FAVOURABLY to…', 'These observations suggest that WRN dependency is not SIMPLY a result of…'. Note the contrast that makes this a clean class: adverbs over ADJECTIVES *are* encoded as the adjective's degree ('most commonly observed', 'highly concordant' — both pinned), so the gap is specifically the verb-modifying adverb. 'not simply X' is not 'not X', so these cannot be pinned with a caveat. (b) A PP CANNOT ATTACH TO A NON-SUBJECT NOMINAL — 'Scientists can exploit synthetic lethality FOR CANCER THERAPEUTICS' (the purpose PP either nests into the object or splits the 'cancer therapeutics' compound; the VP-adjunct reading is absent) and 'Synthetic lethality is an interaction BETWEEN TWO GENETIC EVENTS' (the complement PP of the predicate nominal attaches to the SUBJECT in all four readings). (c) COORDINATION SCOPE — 'Depletion of WRN promoted apoptosis and cell cycle arrest IN MSI MODELS' (the shared locative lands inside the SECOND conjunct only) and 'This state has FREQUENT INSERTION OR DELETION MUTATIONS' (the Or distributes over the whole clause and the first disjunct loses its head noun 'mutations'). The >5-skeleton tail (13 units, up to the 96-skeleton 4-way gene coordination) is deliberately left unadjudicated this cycle.

history.commit: closed-class surface list shared with WordNet (9f438cf/183f03e) + a bare kind is a plain NP per core-en `bnp` with Eisner-restricted raises (d24deba) + sortal-name guard (a4749f4)
history.note: Three linked findings, each grounded before designing. (1) The WordNet importer had NO closed-class surface skip — only UMLS did — so `as` seeded WordNet's arsenic (14629149) and American_Samoa (08991878) as content nouns and the page's worst unit parsed as a compound pile, *"a Microsatellite-Instability As dependency"*, 19 skeletons. The shared list moved to the kernel both importers depend on; UMLS keeps its own GRAMMATICAL_SURFACES (`lead`/`alone`/negation) because those are UMLS reification artefacts and `lead` is legitimate WordNet content. (2) Removing that junk EXPOSED a real gap: "We evaluated MSI as a biomarker for WRN dependency" had only ever parsed through the junk piles. Root cause found by forest trace after three wrong guesses: a bare kind was available only TYPE-RAISED, reusing the existential determiner's categories, which FIXES the result category — so a raised object cannot fill a non-final slot (the ESSIVE `((S\NP)/cat_pp_arg(prep_as))/NP`), and no composition degree repairs it. Witness: "evaluated WRN as a biomarker" parsed (proper noun -> plain cat_np) while "evaluated MSI as a biomarker" gapped. core-en settles the design: its `bnp` rule is `n $1 -> np $1` (a PLAIN np) and it type-raises only QuantNP, because raising is for generalized quantifiers — a bare kind is an individual under Chierchia's ∩. So the shift now yields a plain `cat_np` (with the mass->sg agreement the raise supplied implicitly); the raises STAY for coordination/composition/extraction (removing them cost 3 gaps, measured) but are kept out of PLAIN application by Eisner guards so they never re-derive it. (3) The plain NP then let a bare kind be read as a PROPER NAME by the sortal-name rule `[cat_n][cat_np]` — "a nucleotide named a repeat region" — because its `ProperName` guard only asks that the type index be concrete, which a kind also is; the TYPE cannot distinguish a kind from a name but the PROVENANCE can, hence `Guard::NotKindRaised(Operand::Right)`. MEASURED: cap-only on one snapshot 1560 readings/196 skeletons/gap 1 -> 885/140/gap 0 after the name guard. Reranked drift-free (record == replay): readings 720 -> 366, skeletons 169 -> 150, encoded 9 -> 12, grammar-gap 0, 23/23. The 19-skeleton outlier is gone (max is now 10) and 49 of 62 units sit at 1-2 skeletons. NOTE ON THE DRAW: an earlier draw missed "Each event alone does not lead to cell death"; a worktree A/B (same ranks, pre-change code) reproduced the miss, proving it was NOT this work. `lead` has 14 verb senses of which FOUR carry frame 04 (02555908 "be conducive to", 02635956 "tend to or result in", …) competing for a 2-slot cap, so the unit turns on the documented ~5% temperature-0 draw variance. history.commit: adjective-outside NF extended to derived verbal modifiers (a8f17a7, parser-only NO reseed)
history.note: The nominal-modification NF (D63 §3.3) forbids a compound over a MODIFIER-refined noun, giving a modifier stack the single canonical derivation adj*(compound-core(N)). Its predicate `is_adjective_refined` matched only the DEGREE axioms (gt/lt) — deliberately positive, because an over-broad 'anything not a compound' version once exploded `MSI as a biomarker` under widen. That left DERIVED VERBAL modifiers out of scope: the denominal suffix `PCR-based` -> base(x, PCR) and the reduced-passive participial `predicted` -> exists a. predict(x, a), whose restrictor is a VERB relation. So both bracketings survived, including the spurious '[PCR-based MSI] phenotyping' (it is the PHENOTYPING that is PCR-based, not the MSI). FIX: also match, POSITIVELY, the importer's verb-frame naming convention v{offset}_{tag} — which by construction excludes every restrictor a compound noun legitimately carries (compound_kind, essive is_a, named, PP prep_*, gt/lt), so the old mis-classification cannot recur; the reduced passive wraps its relation in a Pi-CPS, so the whole conjunct is scanned, not just its spine head. MEASURED as a true A/B (same ranks, same snapshot, parser-only): FOUR units improved, NONE regressed — 'These classifications were highly concordant with PCR-based MSI phenotyping and with predicted MMR deficiency' 4 -> 1 (and its survivor is the FLAT bracketing, the correct one — that unit was 16 skeletons when the investigation began), 'These findings remained true with PCR-based MSI classifications' 4 -> 2, 'We ascertained MSI status with sequencing' 5 -> 3, 'Depletion of WRN induced double-stranded DNA breaks' 6 -> 4.
